error.message: Does not meet minimum combination of required data points. Requests must include one of: 'pdl_id' OR 'lid' OR 'email' OR 'email_hash' OR 'phone' OR 'profile' OR 'name'. If 'first_name' and 'last_name' or 'name' are used, then one of the following is required: 'country' OR 'birth_date' OR 'school' OR 'postal_code' OR 'region' OR 'company' OR 'location' OR 'locality' OR 'street_address'.
